Steel is the backbone of Arcforge. It takes two multiblocks.
# 1. Coal coke
Build a Carbonizer and bake coal (or carbon dust) into coal coke. It needs no fuel, just time. Coal gives creosote as a by-product.
# 2. Steel
Build the Arcforge Furnace. Burn coal coke to heat it to 1,200°C, then put iron in its metal slot and coal coke in its coke slot: each smelt makes a steel ingot and some slag.
The same furnace makes the tier alloys later on. See the Steelmaking chapter.
